nodes.asset_description: A computer monitor displaying a website titled “Savoir-Vivre Choise” sits on a white desk. A person’s legs, wearing striped socks and jeans, are crossed near the monitor. A green and white mug rests on the desk beside the monitor. Above the monitor, two wooden shelves hold books, a radio, and a framed picture. The wall behind is white with visible paint splatters.

A young woman with long red hair and glasses sits cross-legged on a patterned rug. She wears a pale yellow long-sleeved shirt and pink pants, with mustard-yellow socks and orange-brown striped socks. She holds a blue pen in her right hand and looks down at a black laptop computer resting on her lap. A white spiral-bound notebook lies open beside her on the rug. A black tablet with a dark screen is positioned to the left of the notebook. A wooden table and a lamp are visible in the background, along with a black couch and a potted plant.

An orange mushroom-shaped lamp sits atop a stack of three books on a wooden surface. The lamp has a glossy finish and reflects light. A white cord extends from the left side of the lamp. The books are stacked with the top book having a dark blue cover and the bottom two books having white and orange covers. A small black and white photograph and a white rectangular object rest on the bottom book. A small white diamond shape is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.

A person wearing a white long-sleeved shirt is seated at a wooden table, typing on a silver laptop. The laptop screen displays a recipe image showing a bowl of food with orange slices and a fork. A bright orange bowl filled with oranges sits on the table next to the laptop. A closed book rests on the table to the left. The background is blurred and light-colored.
